faqs.question: How long does bed bug treatment take in Rahway?
faqs.answer: Most bed bug treatments in Rahway can be completed in 4-8 hours for heat treatment or require 2-3 visits over several weeks for chemical treatments. faqs.question: Do I need to leave my Rahway home during bed bug treatment?

Chemical treatments may require you to leave for 4-6 hours. We provide detailed preparation instructions and work around your schedule to minimize disruption.

faqs.question: Are bed bug treatments safe for families and pets in Rahway?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our bed bug treatments are EPA-registered and safe for families and pets when applied correctly. We follow all New Jersey state regulations and provide clear re-entry instructions.
